scope: Opening a saved bookmark first and restarting manual step numbers.

topics.title: Clear step numbers
details: Each set of steps in the Word manual starts at 1. You can follow one task at a time without numbers carrying over from earlier tasks.

topics.title: Open a bookmark first
details: Choose a saved bookmark with arrows and Enter. It now opens even when you have not visited a page yet.
This fixes a crash that asked your trainer to run Check setup. Your saved bookmarks stay in place.
